title: How a highly acidic SH3 domain binds to its intrinsically disordered partner through the formation of an encounter complex intermediate
authors: Jaramillo-Martinez V; Kukreja R; Cohen MR; Mujica A; Barton S; Onwuzulu OC; Cardoso J; Dominguez MJ; Kekwick IM; Ali J; Bell GM; Rice S; Poaquiza D; McClure C; Anguiano F; Latham MP; Ball KA; Stollar EJ
one_liner_zh: 该研究结合MD模拟与NMR/ITC实验，揭示高电荷SH3结构域与无序蛋白ArkA通过长程静电作用形成遭遇复合物中间体进而结合IDP的机制，直接聚焦IDP-PPI的机制建模，高度契合课题。
abstract:
Electrostatic interactions often play a role in determining the thermodynamic and kinetic properties of protein-protein interactions. However, the role of long-range electrostatic interactions in intrinsically disordered protein (IDP) binding is less clear, as they often bind in multiple steps including initial formation of a disordered encounter complex, followed by rearrangement into the bound state. We varied the salt concentration to probe the role of long-range electrostatic interactions in the binding of the highly charged AbpSH3 domain and the oppositely charged IDP ArkA. Using isothermal titration calorimetry, we observe that salt enthalpically destabilizes the bound complex. Molecular dynamics and NMR experiments reveal that salt has little effect on the bound state structure. However, simulations show that salt destabilizes the encounter complex intermediate, which primarily affects the association rate as measured by NMR. Consistent with these results, salt has the largest stabilizing effect on the apo SH3 domain, as cations substitute for the transient and long-range electrostatic interactions that can form with ArkA in the complex. We reveal a detailed picture of how a highly charged domain uses long-range, fuzzy, electrostatic interactions to help reach the bound state, a mechanism that is likely common among other highly charged domains that bind IDPs.

abstract_zh: 静电相互作用通常在决定蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用的热力学和动力学性质中发挥作用。然而，长程静电相互作用在固有无序蛋白（IDP）结合中的作用尚不明确，因为它们通常通过多步骤结合，包括初始形成无序遭遇复合物，随后重排至结合态。我们通过改变盐浓度来探究长程静电相互作用在高电荷AbpSH3结构域与相反电荷IDP ArkA结合中的作用。利用等温滴定量热法，我们观察到盐通过焓效应使结合复合物不稳定。分子动力学和NMR实验表明，盐对结合态结构影响甚微。然而，模拟显示盐使遭遇复合物中间体不稳定，这主要影响NMR测得的结合速率。与这些结果一致，盐对脱辅基SH3结构域具有最大的稳定作用，因为阳离子替代了与ArkA复合物中可形成的瞬态和长程静电相互作用。我们揭示了高电荷结构域如何利用长程、模糊的静电相互作用来帮助达到结合态的详细图景，这一机制可能在其他结合IDP的高电荷结构域中普遍存在。
